description.value: Edo Japan is a Canadian-founded Japanese-inspired fast food chain that has been grilling teppanyaki since 1979, now with over 200 locations nationwide. This Kamloops outpost sits inside Northills Shopping Centre off Tranquille Road and offers freshly grilled teriyaki, hand-rolled sushi, ramen, and bubble tea with dine-in seating, takeout, and delivery options. It is a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the North Kamloops corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the location at #46, 700 Tranquille Rd in Northills Shopping Centre, Kamloops, with dine-in seating, takeout, and delivery all explicitly listed. The phone number 236-421-0028 on the website matches the OSM tag. No bike-specific amenities (racks, charging, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the only parking reference ('Plenty of parking available') pertains to car parking.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast food restaurant confirmed active by the business's own website. A useful calorie stop for touring cyclists in North Kamloops.
